# telnyx_wireless_blocklist (Data Source)

A wireless blocklist of countries, MCCs or PLMNs that SIM cards of a group may not roam on.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `name` (String) The wireless blocklist name.
- `type` (String) The type of the wireless blocklist. One of `country`, `mcc`, `plmn`.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
- `values` (Set of String) Values to block. The values here depend on the `type` of Wireless Blocklist.
